stops.title: Branch settings
stops.caption: Details, schedule, check-in.
stops.speech: A branch carries its address, its service schedule, and whether self check-in is on and for how long around the service.

stops.title: Who leads it
stops.caption: Pastor, ministers, admins.
stops.speech: Leadership is assigned here: the main pastor, any ministers, and the branch admins who can manage its data.
